description: This file exports helper functions and types related to fetch and proxy mechanisms for plugins requiring wrapped fetch behavior. It acts as an index for various fetch-related utilities, mainly re-exporting from other internal modules.

methods.name: resolveFetch
methods.description: Resolves and returns a fetch function, possibly with custom behavior.

methods.name: wrapFetchWithAbortSignal
methods.description: Wraps a fetch function with abort signal handling.

methods.name: withTrustedEnvProxyGuardedFetchMode
methods.description: Wraps fetch with trusted environment proxy mode.

methods.name: hasEnvHttpProxyConfigured
methods.description: Checks if HTTP proxy is configured in the environment.

methods.name: getProxyUrlFromFetch
methods.description: Extracts proxy URL from fetch instance or request.

methods.name: makeProxyFetch
methods.description: Creates a fetch function that routes requests through a proxy.

methods.name: createPinnedLookup
methods.description: Creates a pinned DNS lookup function to prevent SSRF vulnerabilities.
